[[Cow]]s can be assigned by [[Turael]]/[[Aya]] and [[Spria]]. They are generally meant as tasks for beginners. Cows drop [[raw meat]], [[cowhide]] and [[bones]], nice resources for beginners and early levels for [[Cooking]], [[Crafing]] and [[Prayer]].

[[Brutus]] can be killed on a cow task, making it a great alternative for low level players wanting a more challenging fight and getting used to combat mechanics.
